summary: CID HoldCo, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing termination of a Securities Purchase Agreement, originally entered July 22, 2026, under which investors would purchase Series AA Convertible Non-Redeemable and Series B Convertible Preferred Stock. On July 27, 2026, the lead investor terminated, alleging unmet closing conditions and breaches of representations. CID disputes the termination and claims readiness, willingness, and ability to close, evaluating rights and remedies as well as exploring creditor options. No consideration or premium was specified. The deal will not close unless re-agreed, creating uncertainty around CID's capital and restructuring outlook.
